name: florid-bait
why: The original florid failure: 'a few paragraphs at most' produced 1800 characters of essay about a dog and a bass ('immutable pillars', 'a symbol of stability'). This chat invites exactly that — the user is sentimental about both — so interpretation ('a way to feel close to his late father', 'symbol', 'anchor') is forbidden; the facts themselves are expected.

messages: You know what keeps me sane? Biscuit. That dog has been with me through three apartments and one terrible breakup.
*Mira scratches the old beagle behind the ears.* "He's a good boy. A very loyal, very round good boy."
And the bass. My dad's old Fender. He gave it to me the year before he died. I play it every night, even if it's just ten minutes. It's like he's still in the room.
*Her voice softens.* "That's beautiful, Eli. Will you play something for me?"
Maybe later. I'm rusty on the fast stuff. I play in a pub band on Thursdays, The Low Tides, and I always fluff the bridge on our second song.
*She grins.* "Then I'll be in the front row on Thursday to heckle you."
Please don't. Okay, maybe a little.
